descriptionChirho: Qal sense: to be fruitful, to bear fruit, to be productive in offspring or produce; used of humans, animals, and plants, including participial/adjectival uses describing someone or something as fruitful or fruit-bearing.
Hifil sense: to cause to be fruitful, to make someone or something productive and abundant; always with God as subject, expressing divine blessing of fertility and increase upon a person or people.
